typed_core.name: government_id_type
typed_core.why: identity — driver's license / passport / state ID
typed_core.prompt_hint: 'REAL ID compliant' / star markings are a status signal, not the ID type

typed_core.name: issuing_authority
typed_core.why: identity — DMV / State Dept; source validation

typed_core.name: document_number
typed_core.why: PII (highly_restricted) — the credential number; must be masked

typed_core.name: full_legal_name
typed_core.why: identity + PII — name on the credential; borrower match

typed_core.name: expiration_date
typed_core.why: processor — must be unexpired through closing (cheap future rule)

rejected.name: document_title, form_number, form_revision_date, document_status_or_version
rejected.reason: classification/version metadata; document_status (Credential group) is the real status field

rejected.name: issuer_name, issuer_address, issuer_phone, issuer_email_or_url
rejected.reason: issuing_authority carries the source; an ID has no contact-us block

rejected.name: property_address, loan_number, account_case_reference_number
rejected.reason: not present on an ID; no consumer

rejected.name: signature_blocks, notary_block
rejected.reason: an ID is not executed; signature_present is the relevant flag

rejected.name: machine_readable_zone
rejected.reason: highly_restricted; full re-encoding of all PII — no consumer, high leak risk

rejected.name: legal_presence_or_use_restrictions
rejected.reason: prose restrictions; no consumer; leave to catch-all

encoding_variations: government_id_type — 'DRIVER LICENSE', 'DL', 'OPERATOR LICENSE', 'REAL ID', passport 'P<'; carry issuing_authority alongside to disambiguate a state DL from a state ID
date_of_birth — 'DOB', 'Date of Birth', '3 DOB', MRZ YYMMDD; formats vary by country — normalize to ISO date, but the MRZ form is a different encoding of the same fact
expiration_date — 'EXP', '4b', 'Expires'; on some IDs the AAMVA field number (4b) is the only label

open_questions.q: document_number masking — extract already-masked (map to existing id_number_masked, pre_masked true) or extract raw and let the snapshot mask (pre_masked false)?
open_questions.recommendation: pre-mask at extraction to match id_number_masked and never store the full number GEET'S DECISION (LP-438): mask account-like identifiers (policy/account/plan numbers, wire/ACH trace, check references) via _PII_FIELDS; leave addresses and public-record case numbers PLAIN; DOB is unmasked (pii null).

open_questions.q: full_legal_name masking — names are normally unmasked, but this is a highly-sensitive identity document
options: keep typed and unmasked (needed for borrower match)
open_questions.recommendation: keep typed and unmasked but flag for the PII reviewer

open_questions.q: residential_address — promote to a registered PII field, or accept as standard?
open_questions.recommendation: keep typed (out of the unmasked catch-all) and flag pre_masked false for review GEET'S DECISION (LP-438): mask account-like identifiers (policy/account/plan numbers, wire/ACH trace, check references) via _PII_FIELDS; leave addresses and public-record case numbers PLAIN; DOB is unmasked (pii null).

notes: No rules consume this type today, so there is no rule floor. This document is nearly all PII: its purpose is identity verification, so most typed fields exist to protect PII or to establish identity/validity. Aggressive rejection of the machine-readable/biometric fields keeps unmasked data out of the catch-all.

Prompt hint (doc-level): US driver's licenses use AAMVA element codes (1 = family name, 2 = given name, 4b = expiry, 4d = document number, 15 = sex, 8 = address); the model should map these codes, not just visual labels.
Prompt hint (doc-level): Passport MRZ (two P< lines) encodes name, number, nationality, DOB, sex, expiry — do NOT copy the raw MRZ into any field; read the human-readable zone.

PII note: full_legal_name is listed in the PII section but names are not masked by convention — kept typed with pii null (reason_class identity), flagged for the PII reviewer. document_number, date_of_birth, and residential_address are the registered PII fields.
